content.en: Researchers are exploring how to develop quantum-secured blockchains to protect against threats from quantum computing. They are using algorithms based on Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) mechanisms and vote-based consensus algorithms to create a digital signature scheme. Additionally, they are investigating post-quantum cryptosystems and distributed ledger technologies to address the challenges of quantum computing in blockchain. These advancements aim to enhance the security and efficiency of blockchain systems and protect data and assets from quantum threats.
content.da: Forskere undersøger, hvordan man kan udvikle kvantumsikrede blockchains for at beskytte mod trusler fra kvantecomputing. De bruger algoritmer baseret på Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) mekanismer og stemmebaserede konsensusalgoritmer til at skabe et digitalt signaturordning. Derudover undersøger de post-kvante kryptosystemer og distribuerede ledger teknologier for at tackle udfordringerne ved kvantecomputing i blockchain. Disse fremskridt sigter mod at forbedre sikkerheden og effektiviteten af blockchain-systemer samt beskytte data og aktiver mod kvantebedrogelser.

critic.en: Quantum-secured blockchains? Quite the oxymoron if you ask me. How do you secure a system whose very nature is to distribute trustlessness? The idea that we should digitize everything and fortify it with quantum magic only to defer the problems until later is, well... maybe not brilliant. This notion of quantum-secured blockchains is yet another example of "tech solutionism" – a tendency to get hypnotized by new gadgets instead of dealing with the root causes. Exactly which types of data should be secured with quantum-blockchains and why?
critic.da: Er det virkelig dér, vi skal hen: et endnu mere kompliceret og potentielt autonomt system, der kontrollerer vores liv? Hvorfor i alverden skal vi underlægge os sådanne teknologier, i stedet for at rette fokus mod at reducere behovet for dem?

potential.en: I think the development of quantum-secured blockchains is a fascinating and necessary step in the evolution of blockchain technology. As we know, blockchain has enormous potential to revolutionize various industries, but its current security vulnerabilities, especially in the face of the future quantum computing, pose a significant risk. By combining Quantum Key Distribution and post-quantum cryptosystems, researchers can create a much more robust and secure blockchain network that will be able to withstand the threats posed by quantum computers. This is a great example of how technological advancements can be used to enhance the security and reliability of our digital infrastructure, and I'm excited to see where this research will lead!
potential.da: Hvorfor tror du, at kvante-sikrede blockchains er så vigtige for fremtiden?
